decision.why: Establish sample scope, image integrity and available prediction artifacts before selecting a measurable experiment.
decision.hypothesis: The dataset contains identifiable image and baseline artifacts sufficient to design a seven-song pilot, while full acceptance requires all 32 excerpts.
decision.expected_observation: A dataset inventory identifying sample groups, image quality issues, artifact availability and any integrity failures.

observation.label_policy: Recognition sees images only. References are opened by evaluation.
observation.release_limits: Conservative completion guard for this prototype, not a musician-agreed product release threshold. A seven-sample pilot cannot complete this goal. Report measured improvements separately.
